periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 60 degrees downward toward the nasal bridge relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lower cheek, creating a teardrop morphology.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, exceeding the width of an individual ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-red pigmentation/staining of the pelage on the lower torso and hindlimb regions compared to the white cranial fur.
